title: When Skills Remain But Access Fails: Factorized Skill Memory for Continual Skill Internalization
abstract: arXiv:2610.15492v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Skill internalization aims to convert externally specified procedural skills into persistent model capabilities, allowing language-model agents to execute them without retrieving or reinjecting skill descriptions at inference time. Yet when new skills are learned continually, whether previously internalized skills remain usable is still poorly understood. We study forgetting in continual skill internalization and uncover a clear hierarchical structure. Early in subsequent training, a model may lose the ability to invoke an old skill from the raw request, while supplying only the correct canonical skill name substantially restores the learned behavior; with further optimization, this conditional execution also degrades. We call these two stages skill-addressing forgetting and skill-execution forgetting. Guided by this finding, we introduce Factorized Skill Memory (FSM), which separates continual skill memory into a plastic Address Memory

translated_title: 当技能犹存而访问失灵：面向持续技能内化的因子化技能记忆
translated_abstract: 技能内化旨在将外部指定的程序性技能转化为模型的持久能力，使语言模型智能体在推理时无需检索或重新注入技能描述即可执行这些技能。然而，当持续学习新技能时，先前已内化的技能是否仍然可用，目前仍缺乏充分的认识。我们研究了持续技能内化中的遗忘现象，并揭示出一个清晰的层次结构：在后续训练的早期阶段，模型可能失去从原始请求中调用旧技能的能力，而仅提供正确的规范技能名称即可大幅恢复已习得的行为；随着进一步优化，这种条件化执行也会随之退化。我们将这两个阶段分别称为技能寻址遗忘和技能执行遗忘。受此发现启发，我们提出了因子化技能记忆（FSM），它将持续技能记忆分离为一个可塑的寻址记忆……
tldr: 该研究揭示了持续技能内化中遗忘的两阶段层次结构——先出现无法从原始请求调用技能的“技能寻址遗忘”，再退化为“技能执行遗忘”，并据此提出因子化技能记忆（FSM），将技能寻址与技能执行的记忆分离，以缓解持续学习中的技能遗忘。
en_tdlr: This work uncovers a two-stage hierarchical structure of forgetting in continual skill internalization—skill-addressing forgetting followed by skill-execution forgetting—and proposes Factorized Skill Memory (FSM), which disentangles skill addressing from skill execution to mitigate forgetting during continual learning.
